title: Nicole K Probable NDE 5419
content: I saw Heaven and there were white clouds, which didn't look so much like clouds but more like large puffy cotton balls. It felt wonderful and warm. A very bright light hit my eyes but did not dazzle me. It was so quiet and peaceful. I wanted to stay in that place. I so much did not want to leave that location! I was wearing a summer dress and felt like a happy little girl. Then out of the clouds came a pair of big wonderful hands! I reached out to take hold of them. The hands were comfortable, warm and soft. I felt totally secure, fine, and safe having a strong grip on these hands. I knew, 'I'm home.' After happily holding these hands for a while, I suddenly I heard a voice that told me that I had to release those hands and go back. I start to cry and scream, full of despair, 'Please don't leave me, and I want to stay here!' The voice answered, 'You have to go back.' I had a strong grip on the hands, but then they started to recede back into heaven, and my hands stayed where they were. After all that happened, I woke up and found out that I had been in a coma for seven weeks. That peace, which surrounds me still, that endless feeling of safety, I have never forgotten, and will never forget, from that day onward. The pain of my longing to go back to that place stayed with me for a very long time. I couldn't do anything myself about going back there, because I was very sure that if I committed suicide, I would not go back to that place. Suicides go to another place.

arrival.other_being_detail: A pair of big wonderful hands came out of the clouds; later a voice told her to release the hands and go back.

environment.environment_other_detail: Heaven with white clouds like large puffy cotton balls; very quiet and peaceful; felt wonderful and warm; very bright light that did not dazzle.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Encounter with large comforting hands emerging from the clouds; strong desire to stay; told by a voice to release and go back; woke from a seven-week coma.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE or tunnel described; directly in a heavenly cloud environment with light, then encounter with hands and a voice, then forced return/waking.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The primary 'being' was experienced as a pair of big, warm, soft hands emerging from the clouds; she wore a summer dress and felt like a happy little girl; she believed suicide would prevent returning to that place ('Suicides go to another place').
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I'm home." / "You have to go back." / "Please don't leave me, and I want to stay here!" / "Suicides go to another place."
